Refined. Elegant. The most natural way to embrace the moment begins here. Because every detail is thoughtfully designed to slow time down and let you feel serenity. At Paloma Finesse, modern, clean and sophisticated design meets soft shades of grey to create a truly distinctive atmosphere. The signature sculptural installation "Wisdom Stone" offers an impressive first welcome. From the lobby onward, contemporary lines flow seamlessly through the courtyard where the sculpture stands, guiding you toward the iconic 80-metre pool, expansive gardens spread across 8 hectares, and a 350-metre sandy beach opening onto the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean, creating a natural, uninterrupted journey between spaces. FINESSE (noun) great skill or style (verb) 1. to improve something so it is the best it can possibly be 2. to do something with a lot of skill and style IT IS STILL- NESS OF PERFEC- TION. Massimo Vignelli Created with organic forms by Günnur Özsoy, Wisdom Stone is a contemporary interpretation of the protective and healing stone symbol found in mythology. Rising from the water, this striking form represents a quiet strength that withstands time, a human-centred presence inviting reflection and connection. WIS- DOM STO- NE IN THE SPOTLIGHT BEACH The 350-metre stretch of golden sand meets the pure beauty of the turquoise sea, creating an exclusive beach experience that reflects the timeless elegance of the Mediterranean. CHEF'S KITCHEN A different chef every week, a unique gastronomic experience every time... Since 2019, Chef's Kitchen has remained the world’s first and only concept of its kind, offering a culinary journey without borders. At Chef's Kitchen, where a new chef takes over the kitchen each week, culinary masters bring their signature touches and cultural heritage to the table through exclusive menus. As a result, every visit transforms into a brand-new flavor experience that transcends boundaries. PALOMAQUA As the largest and most comprehensive water park in the region with 19 slides, Palomaqua is Turkey’s first facility to hold the Safe Fun certification, offering guests of all ages a water adventure filled with both confidence and excitement. SOPHISTICATED & MINIMALIST DESIGN Spacious architecture is the key element of Paloma Finesse Paloma Finesse offers a unique place where you can experience the feeling of freedom that with spacious, sophisticated architecture that makes a new definition of luxury. While the sparse and uncluttered layout make the hotel feel very modern, the unique blend of minimalist and Mediterranean design creates a calming setting featuring subdued colors with accents of rich gray. FAMILY FINE LINE A perfect place for families who want to spend a lifestyle holiday with kids. Paloma Finesse, with its ideal structure, spacious architecture and a wide range of facilities, is a unique place for families who are looking for calm and comfortable atmosphere, qualified entertainment, activities for teens and children, natural and gourmet delights. In the family suites all details are considered for you to enjoy the large spaces with the maximum comfort with your family. Children can enjoy their holiday with the healthy and delicious meals at the Kids’ Buffet and wide range of fun activities at "The Play House"; while those, who desire to engage in exciting adventures, can have unlimited fun at Palomaqua with its 12 adult-only slides and 7 children’s slides. YUZU GARDEN Yuzu Garden, inspired by the calm, meditative, spacious-area, stone and rock-dominated form of Zen gardens, was enriched with tropical plants suitable with Finesse's geography. Thence, the concept has become a natural flow with the Wabi-Sabi philosophy, where order and clutter go together. The "tree of life" at the heart of the garden and the shade of ​​the Ficus were created as a resting place where people gather together under the tree and think about both their own lives and the world they live in. In fine, Yuzu Garden & Finesse; a space to stand, see, taste, be alone/to be one and admire. DISCOVER ROOMS Paloma Finesse offers 60 spacious swim-up rooms, elegantly designed with a modern aesthetic, featuring private terraces with comfortable loungers and direct access to a private pool. Studio, family and large family swim-up options provide refined living spaces that bring together comfort and pleasure, adapting effortlessly to different holiday rhythms. DISCOVER RESTAURANTS Paloma Finesse’s groundbreaking culinary approach to ultra-luxury all-inclusive brings together respect for local flavours, seasonality, and traditional tastes with modern touches, delivering a refined gastronomic experience. Strengthened by ingredients sourced from the group’s own organic farm, this philosophy comes to life through an open-kitchen concept and à la minute creations, presenting the finest examples of world cuisine with an original and sustainable perspective. DISCOVER BARS Flavor lives in the details… Classic recipes crafted with natural ingredients and creative signature cocktails add a refreshing touch to every moment. A light aperitif at sunset, a perfectly balanced cocktail in the evening, or refreshing drinks throughout the day… Each glass becomes a refined detail that accompanies your stay. DISCOVER BEACH & POOL Get ready to embrace every shade of blue at Paloma Finesse. Opening onto the endless Mediterranean horizon, the 350-metre stretch of golden sand and crystal-clear waters invites you into a serene seaside experience. Soak up the sun on this uniquely beautiful beach, slow the rhythm of the day by the expansive swimming pool, and retreat to private cabanas designed for your comfort—offering a personal sanctuary that elevates the beach experience with calm and exclusivity. Here, every corner is shaped to inspire relaxation and a sense of effortless freedom. DISCOVER ACTIVITIES Find the most exciting sport that will relax your body, mind and soul... Motivate and inspire yourself to be more active. Paloma Finesse has curated a collection of sports and signature experiences that will keep you captivated. Embrace the Mediterranean way of life at Paloma Finesse and discover the activities you love. Get active with our dedicated fitness centre and yoga classes with indescribable views or thrilling water sports in endless turquoise sea. DISCOVER THE PLAY HOUSE & C.R.E.W. Having lots of fun, that’s all we do at The Play House! The perfect family destination Paloma Finesse offers a happy holiday for children with its ideal structure and facilities. Let little imaginations soar at “The Play House”. Allow our professional child-minders keep your children happily entertained during days of fun, with playful activities, educational events and hands-on creating. DISCOVER FAE SPA With the delicate aromas of precious oils, soothing music, and expertly performed massage rituals, FAE SPA invites you beyond the rhythm of everyday life. Here, every touch, every scent, and every moment becomes a timeless and inspiring experience that restores your body while gently clearing your mind. DISCOVER LET’S STOP THE RUSH AND BE AWARE OF THE MOMENT. Check out the room types that appeal to you, where you can both relax and enjoy the perfect details. DISCOVER CULINARY You will not get enough of the unlimited gastronomic experience and flavours offered at Selectum Luxury Resort Belek. Spacious restaurants and exclusive menus turn your holiday into a gastronomic journey. DISCOVER POOL & BEACH We offer a variety of options for all family members to enjoy unlimited pleasure with a Aquapark, main pool, pool for families, leisure pool, children's pools, indoor pools, sea water pool and an enchanting beach. DISCOVER SPA We invite you to our Spa Center. The Spa offers the ideal place for you to relax and discover yourself. The tranquil atmosphere and healing aromatic scents will revitalise your mind and body and will be the most relaxing part of your holiday. DISCOVER KIDS At Puppies' World, which operates all day long, we invite your children to learn while having fun. Our mini club, where they can get to know different cultures, make new friends, spend time without the need for their families, offers board games selected appropriately for their age groups, games that develop intelligence and skills, workshops and much more. DISCOVER ACTIVITIES Selectum Luxury Resort Belek changes its atmosphere with unique theme parties to add an unforgettable colour to your holiday. Every day our hotel comes alive with fascinating, extraordinary theme parties. Spectacular performances, mesmerising dance shows and special drinks, filled with activities that will make your evenings even more special, mark each party and create unforgettable memories. DISCOVER Pure Sports Academy, founded by our academically developed coaches, offers a fun-filled sports and holiday combination where each lesson is specially designed. Maintain your motivation with group or private lessons and do not give up your health. Pure Jumps, Pure Boxing and Pure Pump are just a few of the programmes where movement is never missing. Don't miss the trending activities for all ages with Neuro Gym Kids and Teenager Academy. DISCOVER MEETING AND EVENTS Selectum Luxury Resort Belek offers ideal venues to meet the needs of the business world and organise impressive meetings. Selectum Luxury Resort Belek, which stands out among Antalya Meeting Hotels, offers a pleasant and professional meeting experience with your guests, either without giving up your summer holiday.
